// Layered magic renderer. Gold highlights are sampled from the original equipment.
(function initLobbyFX(){
 const mine=byId('moggMine'),hero=byId('lobbyHero'),canvas=byId('heroFX'),c=canvas.getContext('2d');if(!c)return;
 const reduce=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');

 const mask=document.createElement('canvas'),mc=mask.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true}),shine=document.createElement('canvas'),sc=shine.getContext('2d');
 let loaded='',points=[],crown=[],dust=[],start=0,last=-1,frame=0,W=0,H=0,ratio=1;
 const rand=(n)=>{const z=Math.sin(n*127.1+311.7)*43758.5453;return z-Math.floor(z)};
 function prepare(k){if(!hero.complete||!hero.naturalWidth)return false; if(loaded===k)return true;
  loaded=k;const factor=Math.min(1,(mobileFX?480:760)/hero.naturalHeight),w=Math.round(hero.naturalWidth*factor),h=Math.round(hero.naturalHeight*factor);mask.width=shine.width=w;mask.height=shine.height=h;
  mc.clearRect(0,0,w,h);mc.drawImage(hero,0,0,w,h);const im=mc.getImageData(0,0,w,h),d=im.data;points=[];crown=[];
  for(let y=0;y<h;y++)for(let x=0;x<w;x++){let i=(y*w+x)*4,r=d[i],g=d[i+1],b=d[i+2],a=d[i+3];let gold=a>180&&r>100&&g>65&&r>g*1.04&&g>b*1.18&&y>h*.15;let top=k>=6&&y<h*.085&&a>180&&r>105&&g>65&&g>b*1.12;
   let light=gold||top?Math.min(255,(r+g)/2*1.2):0; d[i]=255;d[i+1]=230;d[i+2]=135;d[i+3]=light*a/255;
   if((gold||top)&&x%4===0&&y%4===0&&r>145&&g>95&&rand(i)>.90){(top?crown:points).push([x/w,y/h]);}
  }mc.putImageData(im,0,0);start=performance.now();return true;
 }
 function star(x,y,r,alpha,col){if(alpha<=0||r<=0)return;c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.globalAlpha=alpha;c.fillStyle=col;c.shadowColor=col;c.shadowBlur=r*.7;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,-r);c.quadraticCurveTo(r*.12,-r*.13,r*.62,0);c.quadraticCurveTo(r*.12,r*.13,0,r);c.quadraticCurveTo(-r*.12,r*.13,-r*.62,0);c.quadraticCurveTo(-r*.12,-r*.13,0,-r);c.fill();c.shadowBlur=0;c.fillStyle='#fff';c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,Math.max(.6,r*.11),0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();c.restore();}
 function glow(x,y,rx,ry,color,opacity){c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.scale(rx,ry);let g=c.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,1);g.addColorStop(0,color);g.addColorStop(1,'transparent');c.globalAlpha=opacity;c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(-1,-1,2,2);c.restore()}
 const grainCache=new Map();
 function grainSprite(color){if(grainCache.has(color))return grainCache.get(color);const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=cv.height=40;const cc=cv.getContext('2d');const g=cc.createRadialGradient(20,20,0,20,20,20);g.addColorStop(0,'#fff');g.addColorStop(.12,color);g.addColorStop(.35,color+'90');g.addColorStop(.65,color+'22');g.addColorStop(1,color+'00');cc.fillStyle=g;cc.fillRect(0,0,40,40);grainCache.set(color,cv);return cv;}
 const grainSeeds=Array.from({length:420},(_,i)=>Array.from({length:7},(_,j)=>rand(i*11+j*137+1000)));
 function ribbon(t,k,cx,cy,rx,ry,idx,front,col,white){
  const phase=t*(.48+idx*.09)+idx*2.15;const count=mobileFX?Math.round((100+k*39)*.42):100+k*39;const cloud=grainSprite(col),bright=grainSprite(white);
  c.save();c.globalCompositeOperation='lighter';
  for(let j=0;j<count;j++){const [a,b,d,e,f,g,z]=grainSeeds[(j+idx*113)%grainSeeds.length];const u=(a+t*(.09+b*.035))%1;const ang=phase+u*Math.PI*2.0;const depth=Math.sin(ang);if((depth>0)!==front)continue;
   const spread=(4+k*1.8)*(0.42+Math.pow(d,1.7)*1.8);const scatter=(e-.5)*spread*2;const sway=Math.sin(t*(1.25+f)+g*6.28)*spread*.55;
   const x=cx+Math.cos(ang)*(rx*(.83+.17*Math.sin(u*Math.PI))+scatter)+sway;
   const y=cy+(u-.5)*ry*2+depth*ry*.20+Math.sin(ang*2+idx)*8+(g-.5)*spread*1.5;
   const life=Math.pow(Math.sin(u*Math.PI),.65);const flicker=.70+.30*Math.sin(t*(2+z*3)+a*30);const core=d<.35;const size=(core?1.7:1.1)+f*(2.2+k*.22);const alpha=life*flicker*(core?.72:.36)*(.58+k*.06);
   c.globalAlpha=alpha;c.drawImage(core&&j%3===0?bright:cloud,x-size*2,y-size*2,size*4,size*4);
   if(core&&j%4===0){c.globalAlpha=alpha*.75;c.fillStyle=white;c.fillRect(x-.45,y-.45,.9,.9);}
  }c.restore();}
 function drawSprite(t,k,x,y,w,h){const sw=hero.naturalWidth,sh=hero.naturalHeight;const bob=1.4*Math.sin(t*1.7);y+=bob;
  // Cloth moves only at the outside hem; centre, hands and face remain stable.
  const strips=mobileFX?16:48,a=Math.floor(sw*.27),b=Math.floor(sw*.73),aw=a*w/sw,bw=b*w/sw;
  c.drawImage(hero,a,0,b-a,sh,x+aw,y,bw-aw,h);
  for(let j=0;j<strips;j++){const sy=Math.floor(j*sh/strips),ey=Math.floor((j+1)*sh/strips),dh=(ey-sy)*h/sh,dy=y+sy*h/sh;const f=Math.max(0,(j/strips-.30)/.70),amp=(2.5+k*.24)*f*f;const l=Math.sin(t*2.0+j*.14)*amp,r=Math.sin(t*1.8+j*.15+1.7)*amp;
   c.drawImage(hero,0,sy,a,ey-sy,x+l,dy,aw-l+.13,dh+.45);c.drawImage(hero,b,sy,sw-b,ey-sy,x+bw-.13,dy,w-bw+r+.13,dh+.45);
  }return y;
 }
 function loop(now){requestAnimationFrame(loop);if(document.hidden||!gate.hidden||layer||!byId('moggShopOverlay').hidden||['moggSettings','moggWorlds','moggPlayPanel','moggAdmin','moggEndingOverlay'].some(id=>!byId(id).hidden)){return;}
  if(now-frame<(mobileFX?40:25))return;frame=now;const k=Number(mine.dataset.hero)||0;if(!prepare(k))return; if(k!==last){last=k;start=now;dust=Array.from({length:mobileFX?10+k*4:12+k*8},(_,i)=>[rand(i+2),rand(i+82),rand(i+162),rand(i+242)]);}

  // Luminous spirals are drawn both behind and in front, with a bright core.

/* 3D inventory: closed solid meshes, orthographic camera and moving specular light. */
const toolMeshes=[];
function buildToolMesh(id){
 const faces=[];
 const rgb=(h)=>[parseInt(h.slice(1,3),16),parseInt(h.slice(3,5),16),parseInt(h.slice(5,7),16)];
 function add(v,c,metal=.15){faces.push({v,c:rgb(c),metal});}
 function prism(axis,sections,n,c,metal=.15,phase=Math.PI/8,alt=null){
  const rings=sections.map(([z,r,s=r])=>Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>{const a=phase+2*Math.PI*i/n,u=r*Math.cos(a),v=s*Math.sin(a);return axis==='y'?[u,z,v]:[z,u,v]}));
  for(let k=0;k<rings.length-1;k++)for(let i=0;i<n;i++){let j=(i+1)%n;add([rings[k][i],rings[k][j],rings[k+1][j],rings[k+1][i]],alt&&((i+k)%3===0)?alt:c,metal);}
  add(rings[0].slice().reverse(),c,metal);add(rings.at(-1),c,metal);
 }
 function gem(x,y,z,r,c){let top=[x,y+r,z],bottom=[x,y-r,z],ring=[[x+r,y,z],[x,y,z+r],[x-r,y,z],[x,y,z-r]];for(let j=0;j<4;j++){add([top,ring[j],ring[(j+1)%4]],c,.95);add([bottom,ring[(j+1)%4],ring[j]],c,.85)}}
 const body=['#95542d','#a96b39','#838597','#42c5ed','#e1ac35','#762caa'][id],trim=['#63381e','#e1a45b','#b6bdce','#a4edff','#fff0a0','#f9c455'][id];
 if(id===0){prism('y',[[-1.30,.35],[-1.19,.47],[1.10,.43],[1.28,.33]],12,body,.1,0,'#70401f');for(let j=0;j<12;j++){let a=j*Math.PI/6;let u=Math.cos(a),v=Math.sin(a);add([[.47*u,-1.1,.47*v],[.48*Math.cos(a+.08),-.8,.48*Math.sin(a+.08)],[.44*Math.cos(a+.06),.98,.44*Math.sin(a+.06)],[.43*u,1.04,.43*v]],'#5a301b');}prism('y',[[1.276,.31],[1.292,.31]],12,'#e5ae6a',.1);prism('y',[[1.293,.23],[1.30,.23]],12,'#966134');prism('y',[[1.301,.17],[1.308,.17]],12,'#e7b276');prism('y',[[1.309,.085],[1.315,.085]],12,'#8d542d');return faces;}
 const shaft=id>=4?'#493052':'#754423';
 prism('y',[[-1.45,.12],[-1.32,.16],[.49,.14],[.76,.11]],10,shaft,.18,0,'#ad794d');
 prism('y',[[-1.4,.16],[-1.35,.20],[-1.27,.20],[-1.21,.16]],10,trim,.75);
 for(let j=0;j<8;j++){let y=-1.16+j*.115;prism('y',[[y,.154],[y+.035,.174],[y+.077,.154]],10,id>3?'#5d326a':'#3c2530',.28);}
 prism('y',[[.39,.15],[.45,.22],[.64,.22],[.71,.16]],10,trim,.75);
 const w=[0,.69,.80,.86,.92,1.02][id],r=[0,.36,.40,.44,.45,.49][id];
 // main mallet head along the x axis, offset above handle, with chamfered sides
 const mark=faces.length;prism('x',[[-w,r*.82],[-w+.13,r],[-.35,r*.94],[.35,r*.94],[w-.13,r],[w,r*.82]],8,body,id>=3?.88:.30,Math.PI/8,id===2?'#5f6473':null);
 for(let i=mark;i<faces.length;i++)faces[i].v=faces[i].v.map(([x,y,z])=>[x,y+.94,z]);
 for(const sign of [-1,1]){const n=faces.length;let a=sign*(w-.18),b=sign*(w-.07);prism('x',[[Math.min(a,b),r*1.015],[Math.max(a,b),r*1.015]],8,trim,id>2?.9:.35);for(let i=n;i<faces.length;i++)faces[i].v=faces[i].v.map(([x,y,z])=>[x,y+.94,z]);}
 if(id>=3){for(const sign of [-1,1]){gem(0,.94,sign*r*.95,id===5?.30:.22,id===3?'#a2ffff':id===4?'#fff3aa':'#e481ff');}for(let j=0;j<4;j++){let a=j*Math.PI/2;gem(.0,.94+Math.cos(a)*r*.87,Math.sin(a)*r*.87,.115,trim);}}
 if(id===5){for(const side of [-1,1]){gem(side*.58,1.19,.23,.14,'#ffc9ff');gem(side*.58,1.19,-.23,.14,'#ffc9ff');}gem(0,1.42,0,.22,'#d17aff');}
 return faces;
}
for(let i=0;i<6;i++)toolMeshes.push(buildToolMesh(i));
function paintTool(c,id,t){const ctx=c.getContext('2d');if(!ctx)return;const W=c.width,H=c.height;ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);const ay=t*.72+id*.45,ax=.23,az=-.30;const sy=Math.sin(ay),cy=Math.cos(ay),sx=Math.sin(ax),cx=Math.cos(ax),sz=Math.sin(az),cz=Math.cos(az);function transform([x,y,z]){let a=x*cy+z*sy,b=-x*sy+z*cy;let yy=y*cx-b*sx,zz=y*sx+b*cx;return [a*cz-yy*sz,a*sz+yy*cz,zz];}const scale=H*.268;const pol=toolMeshes[id].map(f=>{let v=f.v.map(transform);return {v,c:f.c,m:f.metal,z:v.reduce((a,p)=>a+p[2],0)/v.length};}).sort((a,b)=>a.z-b.z);ctx.save();ctx.translate(W/2,H/2);for(const f of pol){let [a,b,d]=f.v;let u=b.map((q,k)=>q-a[k]),v=d.map((q,k)=>q-a[k]);let n=[u[1]*v[2]-u[2]*v[1],u[2]*v[0]-u[0]*v[2],u[0]*v[1]-u[1]*v[0]],l=Math.hypot(...n)||1;n=n.map(x=>x/l);let light=.38+.59*Math.abs(n[0]*-.42+n[1]*.67+n[2]*.61),spec=f.m*Math.pow(Math.abs(n[0]*-.23+n[1]*.28+n[2]*.93),12)*.65;let color=f.c.map(x=>Math.round(Math.min(255,x*light+255*spec)));ctx.beginPath();f.v.forEach((p,i)=>{let x=p[0]*scale,y=-p[1]*scale;i?ctx.lineTo(x,y):ctx.moveTo(x,y);});ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle=`rgb(${color.join(',')})`;ctx.fill();ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(30,12,40,.19)';ctx.lineWidth=.8;ctx.stroke();}ctx.restore();}
